nodes.name: drain.rs
nodes.summary: Drains an agent-org member's pending inbox messages from other org members and applies their payload side effects to the running session.

nodes.name: drain_and_render_deferred
nodes.summary: Drains an agent-org member's pending inbox messages and defers rendering them into the transcript until a safe point in the turn.

nodes.name: drain_and_render
nodes.summary: Drains an agent-org member's pending inbox rows and immediately renders them into the message history as transcript entries.

nodes.name: apply_payload_side_effects
nodes.summary: Applies the side effects carried by drained inbox payloads, such as shutdown signals and state updates, to the session and org run.

nodes.name: guard.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DrainGuard, an RAII-style guard representing a batch of drained inbox rows and their rendered transcript, requiring explicit commit to finalize consumption.

nodes.name: empty
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty DrainGuard representing nothing-to-drain for a member with no pending inbox rows.

nodes.name: drained
nodes.summary: Constructs a DrainGuard holding the ids and rendered transcript of a batch of drained inbox rows, pending commit.

nodes.name: transcript_content
nodes.summary: Returns the rendered transcript text held by the guard.

nodes.name: drained_count
nodes.summary: Returns how many inbox rows this guard represents.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Commits the drain, marking the held inbox row ids as consumed so they aren't drained again.

nodes.name: DrainGuard
nodes.summary: RAII-style guard representing a batch of drained inbox rows and their rendered transcript, requiring an explicit commit() to finalize consumption.

nodes.name: hooks.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the MemberShutdownHook trait and a globally installable/overridable hook used to cancel and notify a coordinator when an org member's session shuts down.

nodes.name: install_member_shutdown_hook
nodes.summary: Installs a global implementation of MemberShutdownHook used to cancel/notify a coordinator when a member session is shut down.

nodes.name: current_member_shutdown_hook
nodes.summary: Retrieves the currently installed MemberShutdownHook implementation, or a no-op default if none was installed.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Installs the given hook for the lifetime of the returned MemberShutdownHookGuard, restoring the previous hook when the guard is dropped.

nodes.name: MemberShutdownHook
nodes.summary: Defines the callback interface invoked to cancel a member's session and wake the coordinating agent when an org member shuts down.

nodes.name: NoopMemberShutdownHook
nodes.summary: Default no-op implementation of MemberShutdownHook used when no real hook has been installed.

nodes.name: MemberShutdownHookGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that temporarily overrides the global MemberShutdownHook and restores the previous one on drop, primarily for tests.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the inbox_drain submodules (hooks, drain, guard) and hosting the package's test suite.
nodes.languageNotes: Bulk of the file's line count comes from an embedded `mod tests` block; the public surface is a thin barrel of `pub use` re-exports over its sibling submodules.

nodes.name: render.rs
nodes.summary: Renders drained inbox rows and message payloads into XML-tagged transcript/attachment text blocks for injection into the prompt.

nodes.name: render_inbox_attachment
nodes.summary: Renders a set of drained inbox rows into an attachment-style block suitable for embedding as supplementary context in a turn.

nodes.name: render_inbox_transcript
nodes.summary: Renders a set of drained inbox rows into a flat transcript-style text block.

nodes.name: render_one_row
nodes.summary: Renders a single inbox row (sender, timestamp, content) into its text representation.

nodes.name: render_payload_for_transcript
nodes.summary: Renders one inbox message payload into the transcript format, handling the various payload kinds such as text, tool result, and structured event.

nodes.name: join_non_empty
nodes.summary: Joins a list of optional text lines, skipping empties, into a single block of text.

nodes.name: render_payload
nodes.summary: Renders an inbox message payload into its full XML-tagged representation for injection into the prompt.

nodes.name: xml_escape
nodes.summary: Escapes XML-special characters in a string so untrusted inbox content can be safely embedded in tagged prompt sections.

nodes.name: routing.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves recipient and sender org members for inbox routing within an agent-org run.

nodes.name: resolve_recipient_member_id
nodes.summary: Resolves an org member's id from a recipient agent id, used to determine whose inbox to drain.

nodes.name: resolve_sender_member
nodes.summary: Resolves the sending org member for a given inbox row, used to attribute drained messages to their sender in the rendered transcript.

nodes.name: member_idle.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the MemberIdleHook trait and helpers that detect and emit notifications when an agent-org member transitions to idle, including unfinished-task feedback.

nodes.name: post_member_idle
nodes.summary: Trait method invoked when an org member goes idle, receiving run/coordinator/member ids, the idle reason, current mode, summary and any unfinished task ids.

nodes.name: install_member_idle_hook
nodes.summary: Installs a global implementation of MemberIdleHook used to react when an org member becomes idle.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Installs the given hook for the lifetime of the returned MemberIdleHookGuard, restoring the previous hook on drop.

nodes.name: idle_emit_target
nodes.summary: Determines which coordinator/agent should receive the member-idle notification for the given member.

nodes.name: unfinished_build_task_ids_for_member
nodes.summary: Looks up the ids of build tasks still outstanding for a member within an org run, used to report unfinished work when going idle.

nodes.name: task_lifecycle_stop_feedback
nodes.summary: Builds feedback text describing a member's unfinished task lifecycle state, surfaced when the member stops before completing its work.

nodes.name: maybe_emit_member_idle
nodes.summary: Emits a member-idle notification if the member is eligible, delegating to the installed MemberIdleHook.

nodes.name: maybe_emit_member_idle_with_details
nodes.summary: Emits a detailed member-idle notification including a summary, failure reason and any unfinished task ids.

nodes.name: MemberIdleHook
nodes.summary: Defines the callback interface invoked when an org member transitions to idle, carrying its run/agent identity, reason, mode, summary and unfinished tasks.

nodes.name: NoopMemberIdleHook
nodes.summary: Default no-op implementation of MemberIdleHook used when no real hook has been installed.

nodes.name: MemberIdleHookGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that temporarily overrides the global MemberIdleHook and restores the previous one on drop.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements UnifiedMessageProcessor, the top-level per-turn orchestrator that owns the session, policy and event-handler configuration and drives the full turn pipeline via process().

nodes.name: scoped_system_message
nodes.summary: Wraps a piece of text as a scoped system message, such as volatile versus cacheable, for insertion into the prompt.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a UnifiedMessageProcessor from ProcessorParams, wiring up runtime, session, policy and event-handler configuration for a turn.

nodes.name: effective_max_iterations
nodes.summary: Resolves the maximum LLM iteration count to use for this processor's turn, honoring session/model overrides.

nodes.name: workspace_root
nodes.summary: Returns the processor's effective workspace root directory.

nodes.name: take_pre_message_snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures a snapshot of session/workspace state immediately before processing a new message, used later for recovery/diffing.

nodes.name: record_token_usage
nodes.summary: Records the turn's prompt/completion token usage from the processing result onto the session's usage counters.

nodes.name: record_usage_telemetry
nodes.summary: Emits detailed usage telemetry, including tokens, tool calls, and duration, for a completed turn.

nodes.name: side_query_provider
nodes.summary: Builds a provider handle scoped for issuing side-queries, such as title generation, separate from the main turn's provider.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: The processor's main entry point: runs the full turn pipeline including prefetch, compaction, LLM execution, event handling and post-turn dispatch for one incoming message.

nodes.name: inject_subagent_wake_nudge_if_needed
nodes.summary: Injects a system nudge reminding a sub-agent to check its inbox/wake conditions when the turn has gone several rounds without one.

nodes.name: should_run_post_turn_work
nodes.summary: Decides whether post-turn background work such as memory extraction and auto-dream should run given feature flags and the turn's final state.

nodes.name: TurnInput
nodes.summary: Normalized input to a turn: display text, images, IDE context, resume flag, channel/chat ids and turn/turn-intent ids.

nodes.name: UnifiedMessageProcessor
nodes.summary: Top-level per-turn orchestrator that owns the session, policy, event-handler config and compaction/prefetch state, and drives process() end to end.

nodes.name: ProcessorParams
nodes.summary: Constructor parameters bundle for building a UnifiedMessageProcessor: runtime, session, policy, channel/chat, app handle, screenshot store and event-handler config.

nodes.name: post_turn_dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Fans out post-turn background work, such as memory extraction and auto-dream, based on a completed turn's inputs and final state.

nodes.name: dispatch_post_turn_work
nodes.summary: Fans out post-turn background work, memory extraction, auto-dream and other configured post-turn tasks, based on the completed turn's inputs and final state.

nodes.name: PostTurnInputs
nodes.summary: Bundles everything dispatch_post_turn_work needs: session/turn ids, response text, messages, execution result, tool-call count and final turn state.
